task.title: Verify key scope and map hierarchy for keyword pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Confirm that key definitions in the root map are in scope for the topics where keyword pop-ups are expected.

step.cmd: Open the root DITA map and locate the <keydef> (or <topicref keys=...>) that defines the keyword target.
Verify the topic that should show the pop-up is referenced under the same root map (directly or via submaps) used for publishing/preview.
Confirm the keyword in the topic uses a key reference (for example, <keyword keyref="...">) rather than a literal keyword.
Check for duplicate keys across included submaps and resolve collisions by renaming or removing conflicting keydefs.
Ensure the keydef is not excluded by conditional processing (audience/platform/props) in the active build profile.
Rebuild using the root map (not an intermediate submap) and re-check whether the pop-up appears.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
